axioms.description: An object literal used directly as a useEffect dependency will cause the effect to re-run on every render because object identity changes.
A function literal (arrow or regular) used directly as a useEffect dependency will cause the effect to re-run on every render because function identity changes.

Short-polling via setInterval generates continuous baseline entropy and accelerates hazard decay. Reemplazar por Server-Sent Events (SSE) si freq < 5000ms.
